name: serverUrl
label: Server URL
help: The address used to open TeamCity in a browser, for TeamCity Cloud or a self-hosted TeamCity server, including any context path such as `/teamcity`

pattern.message: Enter the full address of the TeamCity server, e.g. https://example.teamcity.com

name: accessToken
label: Access token
help: Create an access token in TeamCity under **Profile > Access Tokens**. See [Manage access tokens](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/managing-your-user-account.html#Managing+Access+Tokens)
